seoTitle: How to Enable Atlassian Intelligence in Trello (2026)
metaDescription: Turn on Trello's AI toggle at the Workspace settings level to unlock Atlassian Intelligence writing help across your boards, and confirm it's active.
intro: Atlassian Intelligence in Trello isn't something each person switches on for themselves — it's a single control at the Workspace level, and only someone with admin access to that Workspace can flip it. That design makes sense for a shared tool that touches every card, but it also means the setting is buried a couple of clicks deeper than a personal preference would be. This guide shows exactly where that control lives, what it looks like in both its on and off states, and how to confirm the change actually took effect before you go looking for AI features on a card.

steps.heading: Start from your Workspace, not a single board
steps.body: Open Trello and make sure you're looking at the Workspace that needs AI turned on — the sidebar under Workspaces shows Boards, Members, Settings, and Billing for whichever one is selected. If your account belongs to more than one Workspace, double-check you're in the right one before going further, since the AI setting doesn't carry over between them.

image.caption: The Boards overview with the Workspace sidebar on the left. Settings for AI live one level deeper, inside this Workspace's own settings menu.

steps.heading: Open the account menu to reach Settings
steps.body: Click your avatar in the top-right corner to open the account menu. Underneath your profile info you'll see a Trello section with Profile and visibility, Activity, Cards, Settings, and Labs — Settings here is where the personal-versus-workspace split starts to matter, so this is a useful checkpoint before you go looking for the AI toggle specifically.

image.caption: The account menu opened from the top-right avatar, listing Profile and visibility, Activity, Cards, Settings, and Labs.

steps.heading: Go to Workspace settings specifically
steps.body: From the Settings panel, switch to the Workspace tab rather than staying on your personal settings — personal settings covers things like email notification frequency, while the AI toggle lives under the Workspace's own settings page, alongside visibility and membership restrictions. It's an easy page to land on by accident since both are reached from the same gear icon.

steps.heading: Find the AI section and check its current state
steps.body: On Workspace settings, the AI section sits near the top, tagged Premium, with a short line explaining it as an artificial intelligence tool that helps generate, improve, and summarize content while writing on Trello. Next to it is the status — deactivated or active — and the slider that controls it.

image.caption: The Workspace settings AI section, showing the feature marked deactivated with the toggle and an "Activate AI" tooltip next to it.

steps.heading: Flip the toggle and watch for the confirmation
steps.body: Click the slider to switch it on. Trello confirms the change with a small toast notification in the corner of the screen — the same confirmation pattern appears whether you're turning the feature on or off, so read the message itself rather than assuming based on which direction you clicked. If you don't see the toggle at all, your Workspace's plan may not include it, since it's marked as a Premium feature on the settings page.

steps.heading: Test it from a card
steps.body: Once active, open any card on a board in that Workspace and look for the AI option near the description or comment box. Try it on something low-stakes first, like summarizing a card description you already wrote, so you know how it behaves before relying on it for real work. If teammates don't see it yet, have them refresh or reopen the board — the setting is Workspace-wide, but a browser tab that was already open won't always pick up the change instantly.

faq.question: Does everyone on my team need to enable this separately?
faq.answer: No. It's a single Workspace-level setting — once an admin turns it on, AI tools become available to everyone with access to that Workspace.

faq.question: What subscription do I need for Atlassian Intelligence in Trello?
faq.answer: The AI section in Workspace settings is marked as a Premium feature, so your Workspace needs to be on a paid plan that includes it.

faq.question: Where exactly is the AI toggle located?
faq.answer: In Workspace settings — not personal settings — near the top of the page, in a section labeled AI with a Premium tag next to it.

faq.question: How do I know if I successfully turned it on?
faq.answer: Trello shows a toast notification confirming the new state right after you click the toggle. Check that message rather than assuming, since the same style of confirmation appears for both activating and deactivating.

faq.question: Why can't I see the AI toggle in my Workspace settings?
faq.answer: You likely don't have Workspace admin permissions, or the Workspace's current plan doesn't include the Premium AI feature.
